entry.title: Romeo y Julieta Petit Julieta — Single
entry.eyebrow: Handmade step up from the RyJ Puritos
experienceTags: Occasion: Short Cuban smoke, after a meal, relaxed session
entry.summaryHtml: Cedar, toast, walnut, floral sweetness and gentle spice are the expected core of this compact handmade Romeo y Julieta. The catalogue's direct Puritos tasting already establishes the house profile as fragrant and balanced; the Petit Julieta's handmade 4″ × 30 format should add more tobacco depth, cooler combustion and room for progression without turning it into a genuinely forceful cigar. It is therefore a useful premium comparison with the much cheaper machine-made RyJ formats.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. CigarWorld currently lists the exact 4″ × 30 single at A$28.16 and the box of 25 at A$628.90. Strength and Quality are provisional and Flavour remains unrated until personally tasted.
